title: Florida Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Florida Small Claims Court (2026): $8,000 Limit & Fees
rank_math_description: Florida small claims in 2026: $8,000 limit, $55-$300 fees, the mandatory pretrial conference, the new 120-day service rule and wage garnishment limits.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> venue -> Statement of Claim (+ attach written contract) -> Summons/Notice to Appear -> file & pay ($55/$80/$175/$300) -> serve within 120 days -> pretrial conference (within 50 days) -> mediation -> trial -> 15-day new trial / 30-day appeal -> collection
Collection box: head-of-family wage exemption ($750/week), homestead, judgment lien, 7.87% interest (Q4 2026)
